newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Equity-Income II Fund manager leaves.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Equity-Income II Fund manager leaves.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Brian Posner, the manager of the $14.8 billion Fidelity Equity-Income II Fund, has left the company to join E.M. Warburg Pincus & Co, a Fidelity spokeswoman said.

Bettina Doulton, the manager of Fidelity Puritan, Fidelity Advisor Income & Growth and Fidelity Annuity Income & Growth funds, will take over Fidelity Equity-Income II, Fidelity said. She will continue to manage the other funds.

Over the last year, Equity-Income II has had a total return of ranked 22.5 percent versus 22.06 for the average equity-income fund, according to Lipper Analytical Services, giving it a ranking of 68 out of 147 equity-income funds.

Robert Bertelson, the manager of Fidelity Convertible Securities Fund, has been named portfolio assisant to Doulton on Fidelity Puritan, Fidelity Advisor Income & Growth and Fidelity Advisor Annuity Income & Growth.
